speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I ask whether for the number of hours that teachers have spent on administrative work, are we seeing a decreasing trend?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, whether MOE is considering reducing the amount of, again, non-administrative work for teachers, in terms of adding on work for counselling work for the students and even being well-being ambassadors for fellow teachers.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: Subsequently, if the students require other forms of support, other groups of teachers provide the support.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I think I have been asking this repeatedly because, in this House, we keep saying that we are reducing the workload of teachers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: But then again, on the other hand, I hear that we are now asking them to do the counselling work, to help the school counsellors because there is a shortage of school counsellors.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Then now, we are asking them to be wellness ambassadors as well to help provide a listening ear to their fellow colleagues.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: So, I sincerely hope again, we can make sure that teachers can focus on teaching rather than adding on additional workload to our teachers.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: It is not just teaching in the classroom.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, it is not just in the classroom.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: When a child has a problem, the teacher cannot say, "Sorry, this is not my work because I only need to teach you." But this is really, "I want to be there for you." So, I hope that Mr Louis Ng will look at it in this larger perspective.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: That the teacher is one who is there to guide the student, go through the education journey holistically, so that the students also understand that the teacher is available at any point in time; and not look at the load of teachers just purely by teaching in the classroom.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: Any work that the teacher does, whether it is as a teacher overseeing a co-curricular activity group, it is all about teaching and guiding our students.
